name: Hogwash
summary: A bluffing shedding game where players must discard in sequential rank order and can be challenged as liars.
rules_text: Deal the 13-rank deck evenly face down. The player left of dealer starts a central pile by playing 1-4 cards face down claiming them as 1s. Play goes clockwise, each turn the required rank increases by 1, wrapping from 13 to 1. The player must discard 1-4 cards face down claiming the required quantity and the required rank. If they lack that rank they must bluff with other cards. After any discard, any opponent may call Hogwash! to challenge the last play. Flip those cards: if they match the claim, the challenger takes the entire central pile into their hand; if they do not match, the bluffer takes the entire pile. First player to empty their hand wins.
rating_reason: Bluff shedding game, hidden hands, sequential choice, clear strategy
